public_rationale: On February 14, 2026, The Guardian relayed reporting that Claude was used in the Maduro operation, while saying its role was unclear [e1]. On April 3, 2025, The Verge reported similar chatbot-generated tariff formulas but explicitly said AI involvement in devising the policy was unknown [e2]. On April 6, 2025, Lutnick denied using AI to generate the tariff chart [e3]. Categorical scoring would require a defined evidential threshold for 'appears' and a scope and counting unit for 'thousands of other places'.
limitations: The raid report does not establish Claude's precise role [e1].
Formula similarities do not establish that AI wrote tariff regulations; Lutnick's denial concerns the tariff chart and does not independently document the drafting process [e2, e3].
The statement leaves the threshold for 'appears' and the meaning of 'thousands of other places' undefined. The supplied evidence cannot resolve those ambiguities.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI appears to have been used already in the Maduro raids, to write tariff regulations, and in thousands of other places.

statement.excerpt: Already GenAI appears to have been used in the Maduro raids and to write tariff regulations. And thousands of other places.

from_speaker: GenAI appears to have been used
our_interpretation: Preserve 'appears': Marcus expresses uncertainty about past use, rather than asserting confirmed use.
Reports can establish a basis for that impression, but their existence does not establish that the underlying uses occurred.
Marcus supplies no confidence threshold for 'appears'. Assigning one would add a commitment he did not make.
'Thousands of other places' does not identify whether places means organizations, applications, individual uses, or government deployments. The surrounding discussion does not settle that scope.
The temporal scope is prior to publication on 2026-02-25. 'Already' supplies no starting date.
criteria.support_condition: No sufficiently determinate condition supports a categorical grade of the entire statement as written. Credible reports of the named uses could substantiate its evidential basis; verified use would establish a stronger proposition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No sufficiently determinate condition contradicts the entire statement as written. Reliable refutations could undermine the reported appearances, but missing confirmation alone would not contradict 'appears'.
